scope: CPU diagnosis of actual yield paths only; no matched-state cross-run counterfactual.
timing: All absolute host fields are perf_counter. Derived *_s use the original measurement origin. LOAD host completion, scheduler ACK, schedule plan, and client output remain distinct.
limits: No direct per-round waiting head, token-budget or running-cohort snapshot unless present in the action. Output counts alone do not establish token-budget exhaustion or GPU completion.
phase_join: request_measurement engine_call_index=call_count-1; completion_finalize iteration increments before each execute. Require one model iteration per engine call and match index+1.

beneficiaries.dependency: Previously processed native async restore with its own registered LOAD; not guaranteed earlier arrival or a hard dependency of the deferred request

context.source: existing offload_keys and LRU.blocks only; no lookup/touch/key generation
context.note: Leading prefix is a read-only observation, not an extra native lookup result

candidate.reservation_test: conservative full-history-extra + native reservation; may reject legal async partial-prefix fits

actions.next_entry_note: Native schedule entry, not proof its waiting gate opened.
